scheme_name: CLFA (Council for Leather Exports) Marketing Support
overview: The Council for Leather Exports (CLE) Marketing Support scheme under the CLFA (Council for Leather Exports) provides marketing and export promotion assistance to leather and footwear industry stakeholders. It facilitates participation in international trade fairs, buyer-seller meets, and market development activities to enhance global market access and export competitiveness. The scheme supports MSMEs and industry associations in leveraging government-backed export promotion initiatives.
objectives: Enhance export market access through structured support for activities such as Buyer-Seller Meets (BSMS), Reverse Buyer-Seller Meets (RBSMS), trade fairs, exhibitions, and related market access initiatives
Strengthen India's export market access through the Export Promotion Mission (EPM) – NIRYAT DISHA scheme
Facilitate participation in international exhibitions/fairs/conferences/seminars/buyer-seller meets abroad
Provide actionable market intelligence and reimbursement of various costs involved in export of goods and services
Support MSMEs to continuously update themselves to meet challenges emerging from changes in technology, demand, and new markets
Advance MSMEs' position as emerging export players through capacity building and market development assistance
eligibility: Eligible organisations include Ministry of MSME and organizations under the Ministry; State/Central Government Organisations/Institutions; and Registered Industry/Enterprise Associations. The applicant organization should be suitably registered under the relevant Act with the primary objective of promotion and development of MSMEs. The applicant organization should have regular audited accounts for the past 3 years. Events for which financial support is sought must be from the list of approved exhibitions/events/buyer-seller meets finalized by the Ministry of MSME each financial year. Financial assistance to one applicant organisation would normally be restricted to three events in a financial year. The applicant organisation must ensure that one MSME unit does not participate in more than 2 events in a financial year under the scheme. Adequate representation would be given to SC/ST/Women/NER entrepreneurs in such events. While selecting entrepreneurs as well as representative(s) of the participating units, priority should be given to persons who have not participated in such events earlier with Government grant.
benefits: Financial assistance for participation of MSME delegations in international exhibitions, trade fairs and buyer-seller meets in foreign countries (physical mode): 100% of space rent subject to a maximum of Rs.3.00 lakh per MSME unit; 100% of economy class airfare subject to a maximum of a maximum of Rs.1.50 lakh per MSME unit; duty allowance of USD 150 per day for office bearer; actual freight charges subject to maximum of Rs.50,000/- per MSME unit (Rs.75,000/- for Latin American Countries); advertisement and publicity charges up to Rs.2.50 lakh for delegation size up to 14 MSME units (Rs.5.00 lakh for 15 or more units); registration fee up to Rs.5,000/- per MSME unit. For organizing international conferences/summits/workshops/seminars in India: maximum of Rs.10.00 lakh for charges and Rs.5.00 lakh for economy class airfare for foreign speakers/experts. For organizing mega international exhibitions/fairs/buyer-seller meets, conferences/summits/workshops/seminars abroad: no expenditure ceiling. For Ministry of MSME led industrial delegations to international exhibitions/fairs/conferences: 10% of the budget allocated for the scheme shall be spent under this head. For virtual mode participation: maximum of Rs.1.5 lakh for space/stall charges; maximum of Rs.2.5 lakh for advertisement and publicity charges for delegation size up to 14 MSME units (Rs.5.00 lakh for 15 or more units). For organizing international conferences/summits/workshops/seminars in virtual mode: maximum of Rs.2.00 lakh for virtual space/platform/license fee/rent; maximum of Rs.5.00 lakh for publicity cost; maximum of Rs.1.00 lakh for translation and interpretation charges. The maximum ceiling of financial assistance for participation in one international event to be held abroad is Rs.2.00 crore (physical mode) and Rs.1.00 crore (virtual mode).
financial_support: Financial assistance is provided as reimbursement of eligible expenditure incurred by applicant organisations for organizing or participating in international trade promotion activities. The assistance is supplemental in nature to the contribution of the organizer. The quantum of assistance is worked out on the basis of the budget estimate of the expenditure on the proposed event and in accordance with the criteria/scale mentioned in the guidelines, further at the discretion of the Screening Committee. The maximum ceiling of financial assistance for participation in one international event to be held abroad is Rs.2.00 crore (physical mode) and Rs.1.00 crore (virtual mode). For relaxation of the ceiling, Secretary (MSME) is the competent authority.
application_process: 1. The applicant organisation will submit an online application for financial assistance, along with the relevant documents and the budget estimate of the expenditure on the proposed event in the proforma online giving full details of expenditure. 2. The admissible financial assistance would be worked out on the basis of this budget estimate and in accordance with the criteria/scale mentioned in paragraph 3.2 and further at the discretion of the Screening Committee. 3. The applicant organisation must satisfy itself regarding eligibility before proposing the name of MSME unit in the delegation and any discrepancy, if noticed later, shall be the sole responsibility of the applicant organization. 4. While selecting entrepreneurs/participants, the applicant organization should ensure that one MSME unit must not participate in more than 2 events in a financial year under the scheme. 5. The applicant organization should also ensure that the selection is done in a fair and transparent manner, taking into consideration factors like track record, growth potential, export potential etc. 6. Adequate representation would be given to SC/ST/Women/NER entrepreneurs in such events. 7. While selecting entrepreneurs as well as representative(s) of the participating units, priority should be given to persons who have not participated in such events earlier with Government grant.
required_documents: Budget estimate of the expenditure on the proposed event
Score Card duly filled up (for selection of MSME units participating in International Fairs/Exhibitions abroad)
Self-undertaking that information furnished in the Score Card is correct and nothing has been concealed
Claim will be accepted only in respect of those MSME Units whose names have been submitted by the Industry Associations/Government Institutions in the list submitted along with the application form
deadlines: Rolling basis — no fixed deadline. Applications are accepted year-round.
implementing_agency: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME), Government of India

The Screening Committee may, however, recommend relaxation of this condition for reasons to be recorded and allot more than 3 events

Industry Associations/organizations are allowed to participate in a particular event continuously for 3 years. After participating in the particular event continuously for 3 years, they will be eligible to participate in the same event after a gap of 2 Years

Selection of the participating units shall be based on eligibility score card prescribed under the scheme (Annexure C) and in no case an MSME unit scoring less than 60 percent marks will be eligible for availing the benefits under the scheme
